subject: Re: GreenMeadow - Nightband SLA amendment discussion
messages:
From: Talia Ramos <talia.ramos@greenmeadow.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@greenmeadow.com, procurement@greenmeadow.com
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Night window SLA ask for migration week

Hi Neha / Kimberly,

Quick context — GreenMeadow is running a data center migration the week of July 5 and we expect a higher rate of scheduled background jobs and a temporary reduction in our monitoring precision overnight (00:00–06:00 PDT). Our security and ops leads are comfortable with the plan but procurement asked if Redwood can formalize a short-term amendment to the P1/P2 response windows for that week only.

Specifically we need: 
- P1: unchanged (1 hour)
- P2: increase from 4 hours to 6 hours during the night band 00:00–06:00 PDT for the maintenance window (July 5–9)

We understand this is non-standard; we want to avoid service interruptions but need the flexibility during the migration. Can Redwood provide temporary coverage adjustments and confirm whether this will trigger any SLA credits, or if a different approach (on-call shadowing, runbook changes) would be preferable?

Attaching a short migration runbook for context. Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Talia Ramos
Director of Platform Operations
GreenMeadow Health

Attachments: GM_migration_runbook_v1.pdf
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: Talia Ramos <talia.ramos@greenmeadow.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Night window SLA ask for migration week

Team — forwarding GreenMeadow's ask. TL;DR: temporary P2 nightband extension (4h -> 6h) for 5 nights during a planned migration. They want confirmation on coverage and whether we can avoid credits if we provide compensating mitigations.

Key questions for ops/runtime (Jonas, Marcus):
- Can we provide optional on-call shadowing or an automated alerting/bridge during 00:00–06:00 PDT for July 5–9 that would keep P2 at 4h but reduce risk?
- If we must agree to 6h P2 for that band, what is the operational impact on rotation and overtime? Any additional headcount or escalation changes required?

Kimberly: from a commercial perspective, GreenMeadow is mid-enterprise and this is a short ask. If we grant a temporary SLA adjustment, we should:
- Limit to 5 calendar days (July 5–9) and the exact time window (00:00–06:00 PDT)
- Tie to a runbook they provide and an agreed bridge contact list
- Add a one-off credit cap rather than open-ended credits (proposal: max 5% of monthly invoice or $X, whichever is smaller)

Action items I propose: Jonas/Marcus, confirm feasibility and any ops costs by EOD Monday. Kimberly, draft a short amendment and pricing term we can send to procurement. I'll be available for the call with Talia on Monday afternoon if needed.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Customer Success (North America)
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Talia Ramos <talia.ramos@greenmeadow.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, procurement@greenmeadow.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Night window SLA ask for migration week — proposed temporary amendment

Hi Talia — thanks for the clear ask and the runbook. We reviewed with ops and drafted a short, timeboxed amendment that should address your requirements while limiting our exposure. Summary of the proposed terms: 

1) Scope and window: Temporary amendment applicable to GreenMeadow only, effective July 5, 2026 00:00 PDT through July 9, 2026 23:59 PDT for incidents with impacted services listed in the runbook. Nightband hours defined as 00:00–06:00 PDT each day during the period.

2) Response commitments during nightband: P1 remains at 1 hour. P2 response window extended to 6 hours for the nightband only. All other SLOs remain unchanged.

3) Mitigations and conditions:
- GreenMeadow will maintain the agreed runbook (we have the attached version) and provide a single primary Bridge contact and one escalation.
- Redwood will enable on-call shadowing for the week (no additional headcount; this is a routing change) and will run a prioritized alert filter for GreenMeadow to reduce false positives in the nightband.

4) Credits and limits:
- If we fail the adjusted P2 window during the nightband, credit cap is a one-time maximum equal to 5% of your July invoice.
- The amendment is time-limited and will not change baseline SLA language in the Master Services Agreement.

5) Next steps: If this is acceptable, procurement can sign a short DocuSign amendment. I've attached a DRAFT amendment and a runbook checklist for our bridge.

If you prefer, we can keep P2 at 4 hours but require paid on-call premium for staffed shadowing; we included both options in the draft for procurement to choose.

Please review and let me know if procurement needs any changes — happy to join a quick call with your team Wednesday.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: GreenMeadow_SLA_Amendment_DRAFT.pdf, nightband-runbook.xlsx
From: Talia Ramos <talia.ramos@greenmeadow.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@greenmeadow.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Night window SLA ask for migration week — proposed temporary amendment

Kimberly / Neha — thank you, the proposed terms are reasonable and procurement prefers the time-limited amendment with the 5% cap rather than paying for full staffed shadowing. Procurement asked for the DocuSign link and a final PDF (they need exact language for their records).

We accept the amendment as drafted pending DocuSign. Can you send the DocuSign by end of day tomorrow so procurement can route internally? Also confirming our Bridge primary will be Ricardo Alvarez (ricardo.alvarez@greenmeadow.com) and escalation is myself.

Appreciate the quick turn on this.

--
Talia Ramos
Director of Platform Operations
GreenMeadow Health
